comment: The Copperbell Mines' second boss's adds (BNpcBase 14449, all six with layout 9040086): 369 HP, level 17, no auto-attack; 28465 (5.7 s, 121-127 to players) 8.6 s after each of the boss's 28463, and 28464 (instant, hitting nobody). Kawari spawns one (see dungeons.md); its 28465 comes 19 s in and every 19.5 s. From Bob's Chronofoil captures of the Copperbell Mines (2026-10-25): one run with Duty Support (bd298651, visit 0.5) and two Duty Finder runs (69bea0b9, visits 0.1 and 0.3), `questkit chronofoil --battle`. `players` is the median damage to players over the three runs, `npcs` to the Duty Support members; `every` the median time between uses. Hitbox not recorded.
